bindings.purpose: derived: the route A bridge capture runs as the daily account on intelligence-42-daily-staging and binds each collection receipt to the funded run's approval ledger chain; ledger_reader submits _RESULT_SQL_V2 as the caller, a direct statement that reads open_intelligence_execution_approvals_v2 itself rather than through sp_read_open_intelligence_execution_result_chain_v2, so no routine authorization covers it, and a dataset level grant on trends_v2_staging_approvals is refused as legacy reach, so the read is granted on this table alone (amendment f)
